jack_devex: Quick ping — can someone take a quick look at PR #842? It's the JS quickstart updates: moved the snippet to examples/js, clarified auth/examples for API key vs OAuth, and added a short streaming example. Hoping to merge before Friday so the tutorial matches the SDK release. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:

maria_docs: On my list — will skim today. Quick q: did you update the npm package name in the snippet? last time that bit caused confusion.

jack_devex: yep, changed to `@redwood/inference-js` and added a note about using `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var. also added this short streaming example:

```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
for await (const chunk of client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-ms', messages })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```

sam_platform: i'll take a look after stand. can you run `npm run docs:preview`? last preview build failed on CI for markdown linting. cc @ci-bot

ci-bot: build queued — docs/preview #2789. Previous build failed due to missing newline at EOF in examples/js/quickstart.md.

jack_devex: thanks — i just pushed a tiny fix (added newline, tweaked a line wrap). new commit 7f3b2e1. CI should pick it up.

olivia: i'll do a content pass for wording/clarity. one small ask: add a one-line callout about token cost for streaming so users don't assume it's free.

maria_docs: glanced through — LGTM aside from one nit: update the auth paragraph to explicitly show how to set `REDWOOD_API_KEY` on mac/linux and windows. otherwise :+1:

sam_platform: quick functional check done — examples run locally, streaming output looks good. leaving an approval on the PR.

jack_devex: awesome — thanks all. merging after CI green and olivia's callout added. will ping when it's live in the docs site. :tada:
